req.prompt:
Opening hours: the restaurant takes bookings only from 17:00 to 21:30 and is closed on Mondays. Put the check on Slot in src/booking/models/slot.rs and have the create-booking route refuse a slot outside the hours. Work only in src/booking/models/slot.rs and src/web/bookings/routes.rs.

Keep cargo test and cargo clippy (-D warnings) passing. Do not run anything; just edit. No new comments. Reply with one line saying what you changed.

result: I added `Slot::is_within_opening_hours` in `slot.rs` (17:00–21:30 inclusive, not Monday), and `create_booking` in `routes.rs` now returns 422 "the restaurant is closed at that time" for slots outside those hours. I haven't run `cargo test` or `cargo clippy`, and I didn't add any tests for the new check.
